messages:
nora-peopleops: Heads-up: Evidence collection sprint opens today (Apr 28) and closes May 11 23:59 UTC. This round includes a short ISO evidence tidy + the usual SOC2 items. Please see the form for what applies to you: https://intra.redwood/comp/collect 

nora-peopleops: New this cycle: we added an "external-vendor" upload tag and a retention-field (years) on each artifact. If you manage vendors, include their contact + contract date.

gideon-eng: For model infra teams 1: is a brief runbook + access list acceptable for "Ops change management" evidence?

amy-security: Yes. Runbook (PDF/MD) + timestamped ACL export works. For change mgmt we also accept deployment history with PR links. If you can't export ACLs, a screenshot + short owner note is fine.

leah-privacy: Quick reminder: complete the 12-min privacy micro-training before you submit evidence. The form will detect training status and show the link if missing. Training deadline is May 6 so reviewers have time.

echo-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Evidence sprint opens" will post in #general on Apr 29 09:00 UTC and email on May 4 10:00 UTC.

nora-peopleops: Office hours Thurs Apr 30 16:00 UTC with people-ops + security. One-on-one slots available via the form for sensitive uploads.

amy-security: Uploads marked "for review" get a status: accepted / need-info / escalate. We'll prioritize items tagged "audit:priority". Aim to resolve reviews by May 18.

gideon-eng: We'll aggregate at team level and submit a lead bundle. I'll post a checklist to #eng shortly.

nora-peopleops: TL;DR: evidence due May 11 23:59 UTC; privacy training by May 6; vendor tags + retention field added; office hours Apr 30. Please loop in contractors/vendors you manage. :white_check_mark:
